`@interface UIDataDebug`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataDebug.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataDebug.java)

Annotation that turns off, for one UI, the profiler and the hot reload of dev mode.

## Description

Outside dev mode it changes nothing.

## Learn more

- [Dev tools](/use/get-started/dev-tools/)
- [UIs](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/uis/#configure-a-ui)

## Elements

| Type | Element | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | [profiler](#UIDataDebug-element-profiler) | `true` | If `true`, dev mode prints the time the UI takes to load and warns when a frame of the UI takes more than 16.66 ms to draw. |
| `boolean` | [hotreload](#UIDataDebug-element-hotreload) | `true` | If `true`, dev mode reloads the UI when its classes change. |

## Element details

<a id="UIDataDebug-element-profiler"></a>

### profiler

`boolean profiler() default true` 

If `true`, dev mode prints the time the UI takes to load and warns when a frame of the UI takes more than 16.66 ms to draw.

<a id="UIDataDebug-element-hotreload"></a>

### hotreload

`boolean hotreload() default true` 

If `true`, dev mode reloads the UI when its classes change.
